label: Лежать
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for лежать (to lie, to be lying).

missions.phrase: Я лежу на диване и читаю.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. 'Лежу' is the 1sg of лежать; though the infinitive ends in -ать, it takes i-type endings, here -у after the hushing ж. 'На диване' marks position.

missions.phrase: Ты лежишь весь день в постели.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Лежишь' shows the -ишь ending typical of i-type verbs, despite the -ать infinitive. 'Весь день в постели' makes a gentle reproach.
Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Лежит' is the core -ит form of лежать, here describing where an object rests. 'На столе' fixes a static location.

missions.phrase: Мы лежим на траве и отдыхаем.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Лежим' carries the -им plural ending of лежать. 'На траве' and 'отдыхаем' paint a relaxed scene.
Strategic focus: Polite or plural present. 'Лежите' trains the -ите form of лежать. 'Слишком долго' makes a natural remark.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Лежат' closes the person ladder with the -ат ending after the hushing ж. 'В верхнем ящике' names where the money sits.

missions.phrase: Вчера он целый день лежал больной.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Past, masculine. 'Лежал' is the masculine singular past of лежать with the -л suffix. 'Целый день больной' explains the prolonged rest.

missions.phrase: Она лежала и смотрела в окно.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Past, feminine. 'Лежала' adds the feminine -ла ending of лежать. The parallel 'смотрела' repeats the past pattern.

missions.phrase: Я буду лежать и ничего не делать.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Imperfective future. 'Буду' is the auxiliary and 'лежать' stays in the infinitive, forming the compound future. 'Ничего не делать' adds a lazy plan.
Strategic focus: Imperative, singular. 'Лежи' is the informal command of лежать. 'Спокойно' and 'не вставай' form a complete instruction to one listener resting.
